content: Nawu God Duninjh Kawohrnan kore nawu birriyahwuhyahwurd gods kore kabirrimirndemornnamerren. Nungka wanjh kabendjadme bedberre.
Nungka kabendjawan, “Njalekenh ngudda minj mandjad bu ngurrbendjadme nawu birriwarre bininj? Dja ngurrbenbidyikarrme bininj nawu kabirrikurduyime kunwarre?

Wanjh ngaleng ngurrbenbidyikarrme nawu birriyahyahwurd dja nawu birrikornkumoyak bu bininj birriwarre kabindiwarrewon. Dja mak ngurrbennahna bininj nawu birrimarladj, dja nawu birribuyika bininj kabindibongkarrme kore kunwarrekenh.
Mak ngurrbenngehkemen nawu birringudjwarre dja nawu minj birrikuken bininj. Ngurrbenbebke kore birriwarre bininj kabindibongkarrme.”

God yimeng, “Nahni nawu gods birriyahwurd, wanjh minj njale kabirriwernhburrbun! Minj kabirriborlhme njalehnjale. Kabirrire balehbaleh dja bedda yiman birrimimbunje. Kawarre! Dja wanjh kurorre rowk kabolkrokarokan bu kunwarrekenh ngudberre.”
Wanjh God benmarneyimeng, “Ngaye marneyimeng, ‘Ngudda wanjh gods rerrih. God nawu Nakimuk Duninjh ngunbornang ngudberre,
dja bonj, ngurribaldowe yiman bininj duninjh kabirridjaldowe rowk. Ngudda ngurriyawoyhyahwurdmen, yiman kayime kings rowk.’”
O God, ngadjare ngudda yirrolkkan dja yibendjadme birriwarlahkenh bininj rowk kore kurorre. Kaluk ngudda yidjalkudji wanjh yibenmarnewohrnan rowk.
